Name: Shishak, Pharaoh of Egypt
Summary: Shishak, king of Egypt, sheltered Jeroboam from Solomon, then in Rehoboam's fifth year came up against Jerusalem and took the temple treasures and Solomon's gold shields.
KeyStory: Shishak plunders Jerusalem in Rehoboam's fifth year.
LifeLesson: A refuge for a rebel becomes a robber of his son's temple.
